message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 7.0.0 Official Public Release Release Notes
This major milestone deployment architecture shifts Flex into a unified creative ecosystem, introducing an infinite layout reference canvas, procedural motion showcase generators, advanced curve transformations, and streamlined tool alignment parameters.

♦️ Figma-Style Reference Board
* Infinite Canvas Workspace: Implemented an open visual ecosystem allowing users to freely drag, arrange, resize, and group local images, videos, SVGs, code assets, and canvas notes.
* Active Pan Mechanics: Configured hardware acceleration to allow smooth workspace viewport panning via spacebar drag gestures identical to standard design canvas applications.
* Network Media Ingestion: Added immediate stream playback components inside the canvas board to embed interactive, live video nodes from YouTube, Instagram, and Pinterest hyperlinks.
* Project Directory Retention: Tied configuration save files into localized project profiles so your creative boards auto-load seamlessly alongside target .aep files.

♦️ Motion Showcase Builder
* Procedural Matrix Generation: Integrated advanced mathematical layouts to dynamically build fully organized Orbit Rings, high-fidelity Helix Streams, and layered structural Depth Stacks instantly.
* Parametric Attribute Control: Appended interactive UI sliders to tweak physical layout radii, camera perspective distortions, target sizes, canvas padding configurations, and corner smoothing values dynamically.
* Open Architecture Layering: Code output builds clean native shape layers, masking paths, and parent null controllers inside AE, keeping assets completely open to downstream modifications.

♦️ Flex Flow Editor Overhaul
* Easing Curve Calibration: Corrected malformed Bézier coordinate arrays causing interpolation deviations between Flex Flow presets and native After Effects timeline curves.
* Dual Operating Modes: Integrated a configuration toggle allowing transitions between streamlined simple curves and complex multi-node Speed or Value graph configuration grids.
* Enhanced Control Points: Appended handle snapping logic, mirrored control options, and linked influence parameters to provide absolute timing outputs and zero-jitter curve translations.
* Descending Parameter Mapping: Programmed value calculations to dynamically inverse value graphs for decreasing property parameters, illustrating clean, directional downward vectors.
* Bi-Directional Handle Anchors: Re-engineered endpoint controls and vector node diamonds to operate predictably across both positive and negative animation values.

♦️ Flex Command Console v2.5
* Cross-Platform Command Shell: Rebuilt the command shell environment into a universal macOS bundle and a native Windows x64 execution core.
* Global Search Array: Connected a universal system indexing loop tracking native effects, preset libraries, timeline composition identifiers, layer indices, and panel utility scripts.
* Chained Execution Syntax: Implemented macro script properties allowing immediate processing of multi-tiered action commands separated by functional argument symbols.
* Predictive Color Pipeline: Refined predictive UI structures to preserve command strings when executing color shade adjustments via contextual suggestion menus.
* Caret Insertion Correction: Resolved text field editing glitches on Windows environments, aligning arrow navigation bounds, selections, and deletion bounds to the physical insertion caret position.
* Automated Link Scraper: Embedded automated parsing logic mapping the 'download' keyword to instantly extract text strings, initialize the Online Downloader module, and begin resource fetching.
* User-Defined Shortcuts: Added a dynamic local configuration mapper to assign recurring custom operations and script sequences to specific layout keyboard commands.
* Optimized Console Boundary: Deprecated structural snapshot modules to isolate primary search inputs and maintain a compact user interface footprint.

♦️ Alignment Engine v2
* Multi-Layer Spatial Math: Upgraded alignment calculations to natively evaluate orientation matrices for heavily parented, animated, split-dimension, or rotated 3D spatial layers.
* Dynamic Layout Anchors: Enabled instant boundary alignment distribution metrics Relative to Selection, Target Comp Bounds, or specific custom Primary Key Layers derived from selection ordering fields.
* Streamlined Entry Default: Calibrated interface entry points to automatically establish Target Comp configurations as the fallback default option to minimize extra workspace layout mapping steps.

♦️ Icon Browser
* File System Resource Safety: Cleared Windows system EBUSY write conflicts by restructuring asset ingestion so files are never overwritten while After Effects holds target handles open.
* Fallback Cache Directory: Integrated local cache validation routines that cycle new icon downloads through sandboxed directory layers if primary paths register system locks.
* Target Import Flags: Adjusted runtime logic to deploy operation completion prompts strictly after assets successfully initialize on target composition configurations.

♦️ Clipboard & Image Importing
* Alpha Channel Preservation: Programmed the Windows platform clipboard parsing utility to capture raw device independent bitmap profiles, preventing structural transparency properties from dropping to dark values.
* Pipeline Asset Control: Implemented strict data checks validating project paths, current compositions, incoming footage types, and resulting layer objects before execution.

♦️ Cross-Product Settings & UI Upgrades
* Synchronized Accent Configurations: Centralized panel parameters into an atomic FlexSettings.json document to establish global styling choices across all active system modules mirrored across macOS and Windows layouts.
* Atomic Data Saving: Settings data are written safely via secure pipeline methods to drastically reduce the possibility of corrupted program files.
* High-Contrast Interface Rendering: Overhauled responsive UI bounds to automatically map to highly condensed panel sizes and dynamically toggle label fonts between light and dark properties to maintain reading clarity.
